sloka: स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां रामबाणभयार्दितः ।भग्नदर्पस्तदा राजा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः ।। ६.६०.१ ।।।।
transliteration: sa praviśya purīṁ laṅkāṁ rāmabāṇabhayārditaḥ ।bhagnadarpastadā rājā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ ।। 6.60.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the king of Lanka after entering the city of Lanka, felt humiliated by Rama's arrow, vanity crushed and had lost control over his senses.
